meta.source: derived by spectral analysis of the retail SNDPAC.BIN tone bank; this file contains ANALYSIS OUTPUT ONLY (harmonic amplitudes and envelope times), never sample audio
meta.fields: i=instrument, layers=[{lo,hi=note range, root/fine=pitch reference, pan/lvl/vol=mix, a/d/s/r=envelope seconds+sustain level, loop=SCSP loop mode, h=harmonic amplitudes 0-255 (h[0]=fundamental), n=noisiness 0-1}]
